summary: Iteration 38 - Frontend-only testing of 2 fixes in create-service.tsx: (1) BUG FIX: Tags pre-filled in edit mode (pendingTagIdsRef fix), (2) NEW VALIDATION: Step 2 requires at least 1 tag (Alert.alert blocks navigation). All 5 specified scenarios PASS.
action_items: NOTE: service svc_b184a9f7f6db had tag_ids=[] before testing. Testing agent added tags ['tag_coach_perso', 'tag_mental_sport'] to make the edit-mode pre-fill test meaningful. Main agent should decide whether to keep these tags on the demo service.

NOTE: coach@winek.app (user_coach001) does NOT own svc_b184a9f7f6db (owned by user_demo001/user@winek.app), but edit mode still accessible because create-service.tsx only checks user.role='coach', not ownership. This is by design per the tests.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: pendingTagIdsRef fix (lines 78, 107-113, 131-135) correctly stores tag_ids BEFORE setDomainId call so useEffect([domainId]) restores them instead of clearing - verified working
GOOD: Step 2 validation (line 190-192) checks selectedTagIds.length === 0 and calls Alert.alert('Tags requis', ...) blocking navigation - verified working

NOTE: React Native Alert.alert on web renders as a native browser alert which Playwright cannot intercept via page.on('dialog') because it's not a window.alert. The navigation blocking itself was verified by checking page state after Suivant click.
